_what: Proof that the runner ingests from a username alone, with no token and no supplied id list, through the same code path a cohort run would use.
_why: The package claimed this was impossible and worked around it for the whole of Player B. The claim was inherited from a comment the repository had already corrected. This is the measurement that should have been taken before believing it.

against_the_frozen_player_b_corpus._what: The same account, the same eligibility rules, two ingestion routes.

provided_game_ids.route: public HTML game list, capped at 40 pages x 12

against_the_frozen_player_b_corpus.reading: The cap cost Player B roughly two thirds of their admissible corpus. Even so, vibesgalore holds 1,099 rated blitz games in total, below the 1,786-game residual floor, so full enumeration would have made them better powered for the BROAD question and still not powered for the RESIDUAL one.

what_this_does_not_do: It does not re-run Player B. Their corpus is frozen and their result stands; refetching would replace a frozen corpus with a different one, which is not a repair.
It does not change any research rule. Eligibility, thresholds, splits, the population contract, the judge and the classifier are untouched.
